label: Late-episode GO after a rewarded visit to S1, when choosing a2
explanation: Fires only at GO steps, only in the last ~20 trials of an episode (ep_trial >= 80; it is zero before trial 70 and fires most in trials 90-99), and only when the reward input is 1 (the previous trial was rewarded). Within that, it is concentrated on trials where the previous trial reached S1 and was rewarded, mostly via a rare a2->S1 transition (prev_common=0, prev_action=2: 79% of the mass), and where the agent is about to choose a2 (model_act==2, policy logit strongly toward a2, choice in about -9..-4). The strongest activations come at GO steps late in runs of repeated a2 choices that keep landing rare in S1 and getting rewarded, and they rise along the run (0.75 -> 0.9 -> 1.0). Value is low on these steps (bottom third). Never fires at D1 or D2, after unrewarded trials, or early in the episode. Misses (about 25% of mass) are mostly weaker activations at GO after a common a1->S1 reward where the agent picks a1 again. Choosing a2 (the agent own policy output at GO) is an observed variable, not future. The dependence on the episode clock suggests the feature reads a slowly drifting hidden-state direction combined with the reward/S1 signal. Dev F1 is 0.73.
